question: What request is made to the eternal one regarding the meaning of a dream?
premises: Dreams contain desired and undesired signs
An eternal power can interpret them
inference: The eternal one is asked to declare the desired and undesired meanings of the speaker's dream.
uncertainties: śāśvata may be a vocative epithet of the dream lord
plain_english: O eternal one, declare to me the desired and undesired meanings of my dream.
